ETMP.description: Element Temperature (ETMP). A single ITEMS array holds one entry per element-temperature assignment; each entry pairs a static load case name with a uniform element temperature value.

ITEMS.description: List of element temperature assignments for this element key. Each object carries a load case name and a temperature value.

ID.description: Serial number of the assignment within this element key. Multiple temperature loads on the same element are distinguished by ID.

LCNAME.description: Static load case name (D_LCOM_STATIC) the temperature belongs to. Must match an existing load case; the handler rejects unknown names.

GROUP_NAME.description: Name of the load group this assignment belongs to. Optional; if non-empty it must match an existing load group, otherwise the handler rejects it. Empty string means no group.

TEMP.description: Uniform element temperature value applied to the element.
